name: Reset_Handler
comment: Reset entry from the vector table; LKS32 Cortex-M0 application startup.

name: armcc_runtime_entry
comment: ARMCC reset-time runtime and scatter-loading entry reached after SystemInit.

name: armcc_scatterload_dispatcher
comment: ARMCC scatter-load dispatcher reached from the reset-time runtime entry.

name: application_entry
comment: Application entry reached after scatter loading; initializes and enters the cooperative scheduler.

name: system_init_set_vtor
comment: SystemInit stage that relocates SCB VTOR to the application vector table at 0x2800.

name: regional_or_hardware_init
comment: Provisional behavior name; called by the main scheduler during initialization.

name: controller_init_stage
comment: Provisional initialization routine called by the scheduler.

name: cruise_control_state_update
comment: Periodic cruise-control state machine; identity validated by scheduler cross-reference.

name: ride_mode_and_speed_target_update
comment: Periodic mode and target-speed update; modes 1 2 3 and 11 observed.

name: kick_start_state_update
comment: Uses signed wheel speed and two hysteresis thresholds.

name: speed_variant_config_init
comment: Parses the five-digit product or variant identifier and builds the speed profile.

name: uart_command_parser
comment: Large UART packet parser handling command families 0x51 0x52 and 0x53.

name: main_scheduler_loop
comment: Main cooperative scheduler with modulo 5 10 100 and 250 task counters.

name: pedestrian_speed_immediate
comment: Probable mode 0x0B target-speed immediate; stock instruction movs r0 62.

name: kick_start_lower_threshold
comment: Lower kick-start hysteresis threshold; stock 30 or 3.0 km per hour in x10 units.

name: kick_start_upper_threshold
comment: Upper kick-start activation threshold; stock 50 or 5.0 km per hour in x10 units.

name: cruise_variant_restriction

name: drive_speed_load_patch_site

name: sport_speed_load_patch_site

name: restricted_profile_skip_branch

name: drive_speed_literal_slot

name: sport_speed_literal_slot

name: cruise_enabled_uart_bit

name: reported_firmware_version
